name: How can green remodeling improve indoor air quality?

mainEntity.name: How can green remodeling improve indoor air quality?

acceptedAnswer.text: Green remodeling improves indoor air quality by focusing on ventilation, using low-VOC (Volatile Organic Compound) paints and finishes, and selecting natural, non-toxic materials. Proper sealing and filtration systems also play a crucial role in preventing outdoor pollutants from entering your home. A practical tradeoff is that some advanced ventilation systems might have higher upfront costs but significantly reduce allergens and toxins, especially beneficial in urban areas like Oakland or San Francisco where air quality can be a concern.
acceptedAnswer.description: Green remodeling improves indoor air quality through ventilation, low-VOC materials, and filtration, reducing allergens and toxins.
